# Experiment A pilot (Design00 Part III; pilot scope agreed 2026-10-07)
experiment: A
run_name: pilotA
master_seed: 20261008

paths:
  sample: artifacts/sample.jsonl
  pool: artifacts/pool.jsonl
  paragraphs: artifacts/paragraphs.jsonl
  runs_dir: runs

sample_subset: pilot          # "pilot" (first 150) or "all" (500)
n_levels: [0, 4]              # pilot; full study [0, 1, 2, 4]
n_max: 4                      # fixes the nested draws; must not change between pilot and full study
t_max: 6
design_t_levels: [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]   # all of 1..6 are logged; these are the reported design levels
rank_band: [1, 50]
pool_type: bm25_hotpot_corpus_top50
batch_size: 256               # questions per generate() call

prompt_id: simrag_force_answer_noabstain
log_prompts: true             # write the full user content per record to prompts.jsonl

generator:
  backend: stub               # "stub" on CPU; "vllm" on the A40
  model: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
  params: 8.03e9
  dtype: float16
  max_model_len: 8192
  max_new_tokens: 256
  temperature: 0.0
  top_p: 1.0
  seed: 0
